svg.text: Harvard vs Von Neumann - P2 - memory-heavy program
Same program on both cores. Harvard finishes in 10 cycles, Von Neumann in 17 cycles. Values sampled mid-cycle (falling clock edge).
Harvard: instruction fetch and data-memory access in the SAME cycle (separate IMEM and DMEM ports)
Von Neumann: the single shared port is busy with the data access, so the next fetch waits one cycle (stall)
first cycle in which the core is halted
